core_meaning.primary_meaning: Alassane corresponds to the Arabic form الْحَسَن and is glossed in this record as “Good, handsome.” The record associates the form with root ح س ن (ḥ-s-n). The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Alassane corresponds to the Arabic form الْحَسَن (Arabic root ح س ن (ḥ-s-n); الْحَسَن (al-Ḥasan)). Its core sense is alassane; hasan (west african form). Alassane is the West African form of Arabic الْحَسَن (al-Ḥasan), meaning 'good, handsome'.
